basic_details.job_title: SDAU Course Co-ordinator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University (SDAU), Gujarat, will engage a Course Co-ordinator on contract at its Swami Vivekanand IAS Study Centre, for Rs. 50,000 per month for one year. The applicant must be a postgraduate in any discipline who has passed the UPSC/GPSC Civil Services Preliminary examination within the last 5 years. Applications are online at sdau.edu.in/career from 6 November 2026 (11:00 AM) to 21 November 2026 (11:58 PM).

how_to_apply: Open the SDAU career page at https://www.sdau.edu.in/career, where the notice asks eligible candidates to apply online.
Apply between 6 November 2026 (11:00 AM) and 21 November 2026 (11:58 PM).
Use the online application link printed in the notice: https://forms.gle/DHtt8QbquLv9Ad6o8.
The notice does not list any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: SDAU Course Co-ordinator at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About SDAU
content_sections.text: Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University is located at Sardarkrushinagar-385506, Gujarat. The notice is issued for its Swami Vivekanand IAS Study Centre and is signed by the Centre Co-ordinator. The appointment is on contract.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates with more experience and/or a higher educational qualification will be given first preference. The notice prints no age limit and no separate experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate in any discipline, and has passed the UPSC/GPSC Civil Services Preliminary examination within the last 5 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for the Course Co-ordinator is Rs. 50,000/- per month for 01 year, on a contract basis. The notice names no allowances.

The notice does not list any documents to attach.
